chapter: Early life and New Orleans bands
title: Birth, move to New Orleans and first instrument
summary: Duhé was born in 1887, went to New Orleans around 1901, and began on guitar in a family band in Laplace.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now, where were you born, Mr. Dewey? I was born in the Playa Rue, 1887. What's the exact...
April 30th. Yeah. And when did you go to New Orleans?

When you're alone, you have to answer all the time. Oh, yeah, that's right. I remember, 1901 when Jack Dawson lied on to just work up in 91. But I wasn't involved in long before then, but I can't remember what year it was.
Long before 1901. What was your first instrument? What did you start to play? My first instrument was a guitar. A guitar.

We had a brother's band in Laplace. My mother was a singer, my grandmother was a dancer. My daddy was a violin player. My older brother trombone player. The doctor played bass violin, guitar, and I had a cousin playing. We had a brother the whole day's band in Laplace. So the clan that played a dad and I, that made me put the clan at home. We began to run up the scale. The first thing you know I was playing the tune. And playing since.
